text: Phoebe Lancaster is a Staff Backend Engineer at VirtuosoTech Solutions, bringing 10 years of expertise in enterprise software development. Her work centers on scalable systems, with a focus on building resilient architectures and optimizing performance for global-scale applications. At VirtuosoTech, she leads Kubernetes deployments that handle millions of requests daily, driving reliability and reducing downtime by 30% across critical services. Her AWS infrastructure designs underpin the company’s cloud strategy, balancing cost efficiency with security and scalability. A strong advocate for open-source tools, she mentors teams on Go, PostgreSQL, and Python, shaping best practices for microservices and data pipelines. Her CI/CD pipelines, built on AWS and integrated with Kubernetes, streamline deployment cycles and enhance team productivity. MongoDB remains a cornerstone for data aggregation, supporting real-time analytics in high-traffic environments. With a knack for solving complex problems, Phoebe collaborates cross-functionally to align technical solutions with business goals, ensuring systems evolve alongside the company’s growth. Her approach blends deep technical knowledge with a commitment to fostering growth in her team and beyond.
